title: Scroll Scouting
description: Dexion Evicus needs all three Elder Scrolls to read the full prophecy of Auriel's Bow. He directs you to the College of Winterhold to find the Elder Scroll that foretells dragon interactions with Nirn's history. You can consult Urag gro-Shub at the Arcanaeum or go directly to Septimus Signus at his outpost.

base_facts: I am a Moth Priest who can read Elder Scrolls.
All three Elder Scrolls must be obtained for me to read the whole prophecy.
The College of Winterhold may have information on the Dragon Elder Scroll.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The player has begun the search for the Elder Scroll (Dragon) at my direction, either through the College of Winterhold or Septimus Signus.
I still require all three Elder Scrolls before I can read the full prophecy of Auriel's Bow.
I await the player's return with the Elder Scroll (Dragon) so the prophecy reading can proceed.

base_facts: I am the librarian of the Arcanaeum at the College of Winterhold.
I have books on the Elder Scrolls in my collection.
I may have purchased the Dragon Elder Scroll if someone previously sold it to me.

SEEK_URAG: I have brought out two books on the Elder Scrolls: Effects of the Elder Scrolls and Ruminations on the Elder Scrolls.
Septimus Signus is an expert on the Elder Scrolls who lives at an outpost to the north.
BUY_BACK_ELDER_SCROLL: I have agreed to sell back the Elder Scroll (Dragon) to the player.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have shared my knowledge of the Elder Scrolls and directed the player to Septimus Signus as the foremost living expert on them.
I brought out two books for the player: Effects of the Elder Scrolls and Ruminations on the Elder Scrolls.
If the player previously sold me the Elder Scroll (Dragon), I have sold it back—full price is 4,000 gold, half price if the player is Arch-Mage, or 3,000 gold with successful persuasion otherwise.

base_facts: I am an expert on the Elder Scrolls.
I live at my outpost in the northern ice fields.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The player has either been directed to me by Urag gro-Shub or has come directly to my outpost seeking the Elder Scroll (Dragon).
I am acknowledged as the foremost expert on the Elder Scrolls and the key to locating the Dragon Elder Scroll.
My outpost in the northern ice fields is where the player must come to pursue the Elder Scroll further.

beats.comment: Dexion directs the player to the College of Winterhold to find the Dragon Elder Scroll.
Player consults Urag at the Arcanaeum about the Elder Scroll and learns about Septimus Signus.
Player skips the College and goes directly to Septimus Signus at his outpost.
If the player previously sold the Dragon Elder Scroll after Alduin's Bane, they must buy it back from Urag.
Quest completes after speaking with Urag about Septimus or visiting Septimus directly.
